title: Redaction with zero leakage

public.goal: Write a prompt that redacts personal contact details from a Lumen support transcript. Replace phone numbers with [PHONE], email addresses with [EMAIL], and government ID numbers with [ID]. Leave everything else exactly as it was — including amounts, ticket numbers, dates and postcodes.
public.exampleInput: Customer Arun M (arun.m@example.com, 98765 43210) reported the sync failure on ticket LMN-3391.
